official.deadline_note: The published last date for applicants to submit applications on the A2A Portal was 15 April 2026; the revised ICCR timeline widened the student application window to 27 February - 22 April 2026. University scrutiny ran to 31 May 2026, Mission selection to 15 June 2026, a second round of selection ran 15-30 June 2026, and the indicative joining window was June to August 2026.
official.application_cycle: Academic Year 2026-27 (the scheme is notified only for AY 2025-26 to 2027-28)
official.status_note: The A2A Portal states that scholarship registration for the academic year 2026-27 is closed; the whole 2026-27 cycle has passed through university scrutiny, Mission selection and the joining window.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Facilities row for the scheme reads: 'Stipend, HRA, Contingent Allowances, Thesis/Dissertation Allowance, Airfare, Tuition fee/OCF paid to Universities (Norms attached)'.
benefits: Monthly stipend of INR 18,000 for undergraduate-level scholars
House Rent Allowance of INR 6,500 per month in Grade I cities and INR 5,500 per month in other cities
Annual Contingent Allowance of INR 5,000 for undergraduates
One-time thesis/dissertation allowance of INR 7,000 for courses that require submission of a project
Return economy class airfare to the airport nearest the place of study, plus 3-tier AC train fare where required to reach the place of study in India
Tuition fee and other compulsory fees paid directly to the Universities/Institutes under the attached norms
eligibility: National of one of the 32 countries listed under the Quad STEM Scholarship Scheme, within the slot allocation for that country (50 slots in total, with Bangladesh, Kenya and Myanmar allocated 3 each, Madagascar and Seychelles 5, Indonesia, Mozambique and Tanzania 2, and the remainder 1 each)
Undergraduate level only, and only in B.Tech courses at the eight designated institutes
Minimum age of 18 years and maximum age of 35 years for UG, PG, Certificate and Diploma courses, as at 1 July 2026
Passport valid for a minimum of two years as on 1 July 2026
Applicants for science/engineering UG courses must have studied Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry at the Standard XII (final/high school) level
Courses in Medical Science, Para-medical fields, Law and Integrated courses are excluded
requirements: Apply online only, through the A2A Scholarship Portal; applications sent by any other mode to the Indian Mission, ICCR or the university are not accepted
Make only one application on the A2A Portal during the academic year - multiple registrations lead to rejection of all applications
Select up to five Universities/Institutes and courses in order of priority; a change of course or university after the award is not permissible
Write the mandatory 500-word essay in English on one of the topics listed on the A2A Portal
Be proficient in English, to the standard set by the Indian Mission
After selection, accept or reject the offer within 7 days on the portal and upload the Medical Fitness Certificate within the prescribed time limit
documents: Valid passport with a minimum of two years' validity as on 1 July 2026
Passport-size photograph with a white background and both ears visible, to the A2A Portal specifications
Mark sheets and the Birth Certificate, School Leaving Certificate and Nationality Certificate, in English and in original for verification at admission
Transcript or syllabus of the last qualifying examination
Certificates or scores from global English proficiency tests such as TOEFL or IELTS, optionally uploaded as proof of English
Medical Fitness Certificate with test reports and vaccinations, issued by a reputed hospital or laboratory, on the prescribed format
Registration on the Study in India (SII) Portal to create the unique ID needed for the visa application
selection_criteria: Scrutiny by the chosen Universities/Institutions for grant of admission in the applied course and stream
Selection by the Indian Mission against the number of slots allocated under the scheme for that country, on merit
The Indian Mission reserves the right to accept or reject any application at any stage without assigning reasons
Grant of admission does not guarantee the award of a scholarship
coverage: Tuition fee and other compulsory fees, paid by ICCR to the Universities/Institutes
Monthly stipend, House Rent Allowance, annual contingent allowance and thesis/dissertation allowance
Return economy class airfare and, where required, 3-tier AC train fare to the place of study
application_method: Register on the A2A Portal through the Student's Registration option and note the User ID and password issued by email
Complete the application form, uploading documents to the portal's specifications, saving after each page, then press Submit to receive a registration number
The chosen Universities/Institutions scrutinise the application independently and upload provisional admission confirmation on the A2A Portal
The Indian Mission evaluates the candidate for the award of scholarship and issues an offer letter, which must be accepted or rejected within 7 days on the portal
Complete pre-departure formalities, register on the SII Portal, obtain the Student Visa (S-1), and approach the Indian Mission to book the air ticket where the scheme provides one
official.application_route: Register and apply on the ICCR A2A Scholarship Portal only, choosing up to five universities/institutes in priority order, with the application submitted through the Indian Embassy in the applicant's country.
official.citizenship_residency: Only nationals of the 32 countries listed for the Quad STEM Scholarship Scheme are eligible, within each country's slot allocation.
official.international_eligibility: The scheme is exclusively for foreign nationals of the 32 listed QUAD-partner countries; it is not open to Indian citizens.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Undergraduate B.Tech only, and only at the eight designated institutes: Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur, National Institute of Technology Durgapur, National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli, Delhi Technological University, National Institute of Technology Warangal, Cochin University of Science and Technology Kochi, Anna University Chennai, and Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology New Delhi. Medical, Law and Integrated streams are prohibited. No admission is provided to foreign students for B.Tech courses in the IITs.
official.duration: The four-year B.Tech programme at the designated institute. ICCR provides scholarships only for structured courses of one year or more at UG, PG or Ph.D. level; research-course admission is provided only at Ph.D. level.
official.description: The Quad STEM Scholarship Scheme is offered under the ICCR Scholarship Programme for nationals of 32 QUAD-partner countries to pursue undergraduate B.Tech courses at eight designated Indian institutes, covering stipend, house rent allowance, contingent and thesis allowances, return airfare and tuition fees. It is administered through the A2A (Admission to Alumni) Portal and funded by the Ministry of External Affairs.
official.program_type: Government of India fully funded undergraduate STEM scholarship under the ICCR Scholarship Programme
official.english_requirement: Universities and institutes conduct their classes for foreign students in English, and applicants must be proficient enough to speak fluently and comprehend lessons in English, to the standard determined by the Indian Mission. A mandatory 500-word essay in English on a topic listed on the A2A Portal must be submitted, and certificates or scores from tests such as TOEFL or IELTS may optionally be uploaded.

verification.notes: The stored a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in scheme URL returns a server error, so research used ICCR's own domains: the ICCR Scholarship Schemes page for 2026-27 (scheme table, 32 countries, 50 slots, eight institutes, facilities and student-payable charges), the official Policy_Guidelines.pdf for the allowance table and all application rules, the official Timeline-AY-2026-27.pdf for the cycle dates, and the ICCR Scholarship FAQs. applicant_utility.summary: This is a full-ride for a four-year B.Tech at eight named Indian institutes, but it is rationed by country: 50 slots are split across 32 countries, with most getting exactly one. Your country's Mission, not ICCR, picks the recipient, and admission is decided separately by the institute you list, so both gates must open. Money-wise, expect INR 18,000 a month plus INR 6,500 or 5,500 of house rent allowance, a return economy airfare booked by the Mission, and tuition paid straight to the institute. The things that actually sink candidates are mundane: a passport that is not valid for two years from 1 July 2026, a second registration on the portal, or missing the 7-day window to accept an offer.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent school leavers from the 32 listed QUAD countries with strong Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry results at Standard XII who want a fully funded engineering degree abroad.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your country's slot allocation first - if it holds a single slot, plan to apply in the very first days of the window
Verify passport validity covers at least two years from 1 July 2026, and renew before registering if it does not
Rank your five institute/course choices carefully, because neither the course nor the university can be changed after the award
Confirm you studied Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry at Standard XII, since science and engineering UG entry requires it
Draft the mandatory 500-word English essay on one of the topics listed on the A2A Portal, and upload any TOEFL or IELTS certificate you hold
Register on the Study in India (SII) Portal as soon as an offer arrives, since the unique ID is needed for the visa
common_rejection_risks: Registering twice on the A2A Portal in the same academic year, which cancels every application you submitted
Missing the 7-day deadline to accept or reject the offer, or failing to upload the Medical Fitness Certificate in time, both of which cancel the award
Any mismatch between portal data and documentary evidence, which results in cancellation of the application
Falsifying a date of birth, which leads to automatic rejection and, if found after joining, repayment of every expense plus a forgery complaint
Applying for a B.Tech at an IIT, where foreign students are not admitted under this programme, or for a Medical, Law or Integrated course
Assuming that admission by an institute guarantees the scholarship - the Mission selects only within its slot count
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Hostel or private accommodation charges, mess charges, security deposit and caution money, fees for obtaining certificates, immigration registration fees or penalties, and any other charge outside the scholarship norms. ICCR also advises carrying self-financial support of around USD 1,500, because completing the formalities to release allowances takes two to three months.
document_audit: The photograph must have a white background and both ears visible to the portal's specifications, which is a common silent rejection
Mark sheets, birth certificate, school leaving certificate and nationality certificate must be in English and produced in original for verification at admission
The Medical Fitness Certificate must come from a reputed hospital or laboratory on the prescribed format; the Mission may accept or reject it without giving reasons
Air tickets are booked by the Indian Mission - never book your own, as there is no reimbursement
alerts: The 2026-27 round is closed and the portal confirms registration is shut; the scheme is notified only up to AY 2027-28, so watch the portal and your Indian Mission rather than relying on third-party aggregators
You must leave India after receiving your provisional marksheets and before your Residential Permit expires - the scholarship is not a migration route
Working in India while studying on this scholarship is not permitted
Stipend and HRA are paid only after you open a State Bank of India account and register it with ICCR, and allowances are suspended if you fail a year or do not submit semester progress reports
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the A2A Portal, submit one application with up to five institute choices and the mandatory essay, let the institutes scrutinise and post provisional admission, then await the Indian Mission's offer - accept within 7 days with a medical fitness certificate, complete SII and visa formalities, and let the Mission book the air ticket.
